messages:
alex: Hey team — I pushed a fix that resolves the dep graph cycles and updated the migration script. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4152
riley: thanks! quick q — did you have to bump proto version? want to make sure it won't break Dedicated
alex: Yep bumped to v0.12.1. I added a compatibility shim in runtime/v1shim. Tests added in ci.
maria: skimmed the diff — lgtm for shim. two nits: rename var 'd' and add a tiny comment on retry logic
alex: addressed both, force-pushed. also added a changelog note.
sam: PTAL from infra side — can we merge in today's evening merge window? we need the kv-alloc fix in canary
alex: that works. CI green on Linux and macos, flaky e2e still failing on a timeout; I disabled that test with a TODO and linked an issue #2198
riley: Can you paste the test log line? I want to ensure it's unrelated
alex: pasted log block:
```
TimeoutError: request timed out after 30s
at kv_allocator_test.go:87
```
alex: Disabled only in PR to unblock merge, will follow up in separate PR.
sam: ok. I'll reserve 19:00 UTC merge slot. @maria can you give final thumbs?
maria: one more quick run locally then :thumbsup: — canary ok
ci-bot: merge-checks passed (linux, macos, unit). e2e marked flaky.
alex: thanks all — re-requesting review: PTAL
riley: LGTM, approving now
maria: approved
sam: merging at 19:00 UTC; will monitor canary for 30 mins
alex: thanks, I'll watch logs and revert if needed :pray:
